title: Changes to the Money Laundering Regulations confirmed
summary: The government has confirmed it will amend the Money Laundering Regulations to close loopholes, clarify requirements and focus customer due diligence on high-risk activity. The source gives no start date.
what_changes: The Money Laundering Regulations will be amended to close loopholes and clarify requirements.
Customer due diligence is to be more proportionate and targeted at high-risk activity.
The consultation also covered system coordination, the scope of the Regulations and Trust Registration Service registration.
Other issues will be dealt with through guidance, written with AML supervisors.
who_it_applies_to: Law firms doing work in scope of the Money Laundering Regulations.

history.event: Government published its consultation response confirming changes to the Money Laundering Regulations.
